suites.name: Browser functionality and selected responsive/keyboard paths
Source completeness, document links and provenance

browser_method: Unchanged final HTML injected into managed Chromium after native file navigation was blocked. Functional and responsive UI checks. Separate explicit localStorage simulation; clipboard capture instrumentation for binding assertions. Real browser blob downloads captured.
corrected_during_review: Contained absolutely positioned screen-reader table labels inside the scroll container, preventing mobile/tablet document overflow.
Updated the review-bookmark action immediately after saving a previously unselected record.
Required confirmation before removing a record carrying review notes or rehearsal checks.
Bound imported annotations to a reproducible full-dataset fingerprint, not just a partial source list.
Kept hidden mobile navigation outside the keyboard focus path and added menu focus handling.
assurance_boundary: No live telemetry, backend control, monitoring rule evaluation, SQL execution, paid inference or repository writes from this dashboard.
No historical application suite rerun or refresh of vendor/repository status.
Source ADRs and gate states are immutable in this review app; local annotation is not acceptance.
Native file-origin persistence, true concurrent multi-tab coordination, production security and screen-reader conformance were not established.
LocalStorage-specific cases used an explicit controlled simulation; clipboard output was captured for binding tests. Real browser blob exports were exercised.
The static launcher was tested with actual loopback HTTP, but not native browser cookie or authentication flows; it provides neither.
data_handling: No user review outcomes are seeded. Screenshots may show clearly illustrative test notes. User annotations remain in memory or opt-in unencrypted browser storage; export is explicit.
